programs.description: This class combines resistance band exercises with the mindfulness of yoga and purposeful movement to enhance range of motion, mobility, and strength. You’ll learn how to help your child play in and play with the water with comfort and confidence. One parent per child may attend.

programs.title: Parent and Tot 2 (12 to 24 months)
programs.description: Designed for the 12 to 24-month-old, this level teaches children to get their face wet and blow bubbles (the first step in breath control). With your guidance, your child recovers objects below the surface, performs front and back floats and learns how to travel at the surface by kicking. One parent per child may attend.
